name: n8n 2 Production Stack (Queue Mode, Workers, Python)
description: Scalable n8n with workers, webhook processors, Python Code and backups.

PORT.description: Port nginx listens on (public domain target).

N8N_GW_MAIN_UPSTREAM.description: n8n Main (editor, REST API, push, test webhooks).

NGINX_CLIENT_MAX_BODY_SIZE.description: Max request size (form uploads, binary webhooks).

NGINX_PROXY_TIMEOUT.description: Proxy timeout for long webhook responses and the editor's push connection.

N8N_IMAGE_TAG.description: n8n version (official image tag, `stable` channel) for every n8n service; Railway passes it to the Docker builds. Change it here to upgrade all n8n services together.

N8N_RAILWAY_ROLE.description: Process this service runs: main (editor, API, triggers). Do not change.

N8N_PORT.description: n8n HTTP port (private; the Gateway is the public entry).

N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_MANAGED_BY_ENV.description: Create/update the owner account from the variables below at every boot, before the editor is served (no open setup page). Owner profile and password are then changed here, not in the UI.

N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Owner login email. Change it to yours (takes effect on the next deploy of n8n Main).

N8N_OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Owner login password, generated at deploy. Hashed (bcrypt) at boot into N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_PASSWORD_HASH. Change it here and redeploy n8n Main to rotate it.

N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_FIRST_NAME.description: Owner first name shown in n8n.

N8N_INSTANCE_OWNER_LAST_NAME.description: Owner last name shown in n8n.

OFFLOAD_MANUAL_EXECUTIONS_TO_WORKERS.description: Editor/test executions also run on workers, so main never runs Code nodes.

N8N_DISABLE_PRODUCTION_MAIN_PROCESS.description: Production webhooks are served by n8n Webhook through the Gateway.

N8N_SECURE_COOKIE.description: Session cookie only over HTTPS (Railway domains are HTTPS).

N8N_SAMESITE_COOKIE.description: SameSite policy of the session cookie.

N8N_HIRING_BANNER_ENABLED.description: No hiring banner in the logs.

N8N_METRICS_INCLUDE_QUEUE_METRICS.description: Queue depth and job counters in main's /metrics (scaling signal for workers).

EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE.description: Keep executions for this many hours (168 = 7 days).

EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE_MAX_COUNT.description: Keep at most this many executions (0 = no limit).

DB_POSTGRESDB_POOL_SIZE.description: Postgres connections for this service (n8n default 2).

N8N_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds n8n gets to shut down on redeploy.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL (longer than the n8n shutdown timeout).

EXECUTIONS_MODE.description: Queue mode: main and webhook enqueue executions in Redis, workers run them.

QUEUE_BULL_REDIS_DUALSTACK.description: Resolve Redis over IPv4 and IPv6 (Railway private network).

N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts stored credentials; identical on every n8n process. Never change it after first boot and keep a copy: restoring a backup needs it.

N8N_USER_MANAGEMENT_JWT_SECRET.description: Signs login sessions; identical on every n8n process.

N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL.description: Public editor URL (links in emails, OAuth callbacks). Change it when you add a custom domain.

N8N_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Public base for webhook, form, chat and MCP URLs (the Gateway). Change it when you add a custom domain.

N8N_PROXY_HOPS.description: Trusted proxies in front of n8n (Railway edge + Gateway), for client IPs and secure cookies.

N8N_DEFAULT_BINARY_DATA_MODE.description: Binary data in Postgres, shared by main, webhook and workers (filesystem mode does not work across services).

N8N_RUNNERS_MODE.description: Code nodes run in external task runners (inside n8n Worker); main and webhook run no code.

N8N_RUNNERS_TASK_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds a Code node may run (n8n's current default, set explicitly).

N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SI.description: Compression node: max unzipped size (256 MiB, n8n's announced future default; protects worker memory).

N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_ZIP_ENTRIES.description: Compression node: max files per archive (n8n's announced future default).

N8N_METRICS.description: Prometheus /metrics on each n8n service's private port 5678 (the Gateway blocks it publicly).

N8N_REINSTALL_MISSING_PACKAGES.description: Reinstall community nodes on boot (services have no shared volume).

N8N_UNVERIFIED_PACKAGES_ENABLED.description: Allow community nodes that n8n has not verified (n8n's current default, set explicitly).

N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS.description: Strict permissions on the n8n settings file.

GENERIC_TIMEZONE.description: Default timezone for schedules and Code nodes (e.g. Europe/Istanbul).

N8N_IMAGE_TAG.description: n8n version (official image tag, `stable` channel) for every n8n service; Railway passes it to the Docker builds. Change it here to upgrade all n8n services together.

N8N_RAILWAY_ROLE.description: Process this service runs: webhook (production webhooks, forms, chat, MCP). Do not change.

N8N_PORT.description: n8n HTTP port (private; the Gateway routes production endpoints here).

PORT.description: Port of the worker health server (Railway healthcheck, private /metrics).

N8N_CONCURRENCY_PRODUCTION_LIMIT.description: Executions each worker replica runs in parallel (n8n reads this as the worker concurrency; keep it at 5 or more).

N8N_RUNNERS_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Shared secret between the worker's task broker (127.0.0.1 only) and its task runners.

N8N_RUNNERS_MAX_CONCURRENCY.description: Code-node tasks each runner (JavaScript, Python) runs in parallel.

N8N_RUNNERS_AUTO_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT.description: Stop idle runners after N seconds to free RAM (restarted on demand).

CODE_JS_ALLOW_BUILTIN.description: JavaScript Code nodes: Node.js built-in modules allowed in require(), comma-separated or * (empty = n8n default: crypto).

CODE_PY_STDLIB_ALLOW.description: Python Code nodes: standard-library modules allowed in import, comma-separated or * (empty = n8n default: none).

DB_POSTGRESDB_POOL_SIZE.description: Postgres connections per worker replica (n8n default 2).

N8N_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds a worker gets to finish running executions on redeploy.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL (worker drain + runner stop).

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down

Redis.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "rm -rf $RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH/lost+found/ && exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --requirepass $REDIS_PASSWORD --appendonly yes --appendfsync everysec --save 60 1 --maxmemory-policy noeviction --dir $RAILWAY_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH"

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis

BACKUP_ACTION.description: backup = daily dump to the Bucket; restore = restore BACKUP_RESTORE_RUN (see README); list = print the runs. Set it back to backup after a restore.

PGUSER.description: Superuser, needed to dump roles and every database.

PGDATABASE.description: Database used to list the others (n8n's database).

PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds before a connection attempt gives up (the job retries while Postgres starts).

PGAPPNAME.description: application_name shown in pg_stat_activity while the job runs.

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Keep false: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style URLs. true only for buckets whose Credentials tab says path-style.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_COMPRESSION.description: pg_dump --compress value for the custom-format dumps (zstd:3, gzip:6, lz4, none).

BACKUP_DATABASES.description: Databases to dump, comma-separated. Empty = every database that accepts connections.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for Postgres to accept connections before failing.

BACKUP_RESTORE_RUN.description: Restore only: run folder to restore (e.g. 20261031T031500Z) or latest.

BACKUP_RESTORE_DATABASE.description: Restore only: database to overwrite (n8n's database).

BACKUP_RESTORE_CONFIRM.description: Restore only: must equal BACKUP_RESTORE_DATABASE, as confirmation that its contents are replaced.
